planted_contradictions.statement_b: No outbound external network connection was established; the data was copied locally to a high-speed Kingston USB 3.0 flash drive directly mounted at Console 2.

correct_hypothesis.title: Subcontractor Physical USB Exfiltration via Compromised Credentials
correct_hypothesis.description: Contractor David Wright bypassed the taped lock on Server Room B, accessed Console 2 using Alice Vance's credentials, and downloaded customer data onto a Kingston USB drive before exiting at 10:42 PM.
